tei:div.tei:p: bdag khri srong lde'u btsan dang*/ jo mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus snyigs ma la/ nang ngan 'ong ba'i rgyu ci lags/ bdud rtsi lta bu'i gso dpyad gnang ba bka' drin che/ nad bcos pa'i man ngag de rnams la don gyi gnad dril nas bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus so/ o rgyan padma 'byung nas kyis// las can zhu ba'i brda don bstan// gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar bzhag /'gro ba'i nad rnams bsal ba'i phyir// ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa// chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang*// skal ldan sems pa mtsho rgyal gnyis// 'gro don man ngag zhu ba legs// nad ngan 'byung ba'i rgyu bshad na// dus ngan lnga brgya tha ma'i dus// btsun rtsa ba'i 'dul khrims nyams// sngags pa rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams// skye bo ngo tsha khrel las 'das// rkyen des lha srin thams cad 'khrugs// bka' srung ma mo 'khrugs pa yi// nad ngan sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur// tshe tshad drug cu kha ral la// rab byung tshul khrims bsrung ba g.yel// sdom las 'gal ba'i spyod pa byed// tshong dang zhing las dag la brtson/ khyim gso rim zhing bka' rku mkhas// sngags pa dam bcas sgrub pa g.yel// gsang sngags bka' 'chol grong chog byed// skye bo rnams kyang dkor la 'bag /mna' la rngam zhing log spyod dar// de lta bu yi las dbang gis// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'gros pa'i dug /nad ngan sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur// rtsi shing nags tshal rim gyis 'dzad// des ni steng gi lha srin kun// mi gnyan khud nas 'gro ba yin// sa g.yo sgra ngan yang yang 'ong*// sa 'og gdon rnams steng du thon// de'i rkyen gyis gnyan nad dar// sems can spyi mthun las ngan gyis// mtha' mi dbus su rdib nas 'ong*// mu stegs mur thug du mar gyis// bstan pa'i srung ma bdud kyi rigs// lha 'dre ma rungs gdug pa can// bod du slebs nas 'khrugs pa'i ngad// dal yam sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur// rlung gi nad rtags tshad par ston// tshad pa'i nad rtags rlung du ston// nad ngan thams cad gnyan dang sdong*// sngon gyi gso dpyad rnying ba'i rigs// kun gyis nad de mi gso ste// slar la gnod pas dug du 'gyur// de dus padma'i gso yi 'di// lus srog gso ba'i bdud rtsi yin// thun gcig slebs pas 'chi bzlog zhing*// gnyan tshad bcos pa las gsung ba/

de bcos pa la lnga/ dang po nad la brtags pa dang*// bar du gnyis pa thang gis sdud pa dang*/ gsum pa sman gyi bsad pa dang*/ tha ma sbyong gis sbyang ba dang*/ kha zas dang spyod lam srung ba las/ dang po gso spyad sman gyi rtsa ba las/ dang po bod kyi brtags pa la khum gzer khyor lus po lci/ me nyi bsres nas phan snyam byed/ khog stod rgyu zhabs bag re nang*// yang na bshal skyugs 'byung ba'o// tshigs pa nya bzhi na ba dang*// lus stobs mod la 'chor ba dang*// sgrib pa sgyur zhing snying mi dga'// 'di rnams skya nad dus su 'byung*// de yang gcig tu ma nges te// skya nad mi 'byung rtsar phog na// btsan thabs dag tu na ba 'byung*// mgo la babs na klad gzer te// mgrin pa byung na gegs pa yin// stod la byung na gzer rims so/ khrag gzer gnyan gzer rlung gzer ro// pho bar bab na rgyu ldog yin// de la 'khru lugs rnam pa lnga// sgra bcas chu mdog rlung du 'khru// sgra med dmar po khrag tu 'khru// sngon po ljang khu du ba'i mdog /gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs 'khru// rlung tshad gnyan gsum 'dom na yin// yan lag dag la bab pa na// nya log zhes su brtags pa yin// rkang lag byung na skrang phur yin// de rnams dag ni gang byung yang*// rlung dang tshad pa gnyan nad dang*// mkhris dang gzhi ma 'khrugs pa'i nad// de yang so sor brtags pa la// rtsa dang chu dang phyi yul dang*// lce la brtags dang gtam dris pa'i// brtags pa lnga yi dbye bar bya// gsang ba'i brtags pa man ngag yin// rtsa ni nges pa med pa ste// sna tshogs 'gyur ldog can du 'gyur// nad ni gdon gyis nad yin pas// rim gro byas pa'i rjes la blta// mgo lus gang la bab gyur kyang*// gzhi ma mkhris pa shas cher bcos// rtsa yang phal chen mkhris rtsar 'byung*// nad ni 'gyur ldog byed pa ste// res 'ga' rlung nad 'dra bar ston/ skabs su srin la glang thabs dang*// gzer thung tshad pa rgyas 'dra 'byung*// res 'ga' rkang lag sbrid pa dang*// mdog nag lus lci dang kha 'gags// pho mchin kha bskor rtsib thung na// dug nad 'dra bar ston pa'o// chu mdog dag la brtags pa ni// tshad pa rgyas pa'i nad pa la// chu dkar po 'am dmar po 'byung*// sngon po zer ba'ang 'dug

/gnyan tshad gting du gab pa yin// rlung shas che ba'i nad pa la/ chu ni dmar po 'am ser po 'byung*// rlung nyams rtsa kha grol ba yin// srog 'dzin ldog pa'i dus su brtags// phal cher chu rnams mi ldog ste// zhes dang*/ shog dril dkar po las gsang ba'i brtags pa 'di gsungs te/ nad 'di rtogs par mi 'gyur bas// gsang ba'i brtags pa 'di nyid bya// rlung dang tshad pa shan mi 'byed// gnyan dang mkhris pa shan mi phyed// de bzhin 'dus nas na ba dang*// rkyang ba bab nas na ba dang*// gnyis gnyis log nas srog la rgol// de la brtags pa 'di lta ste// chu mdog g.ya' chu lta bu la// brtags pas ldog tu ma 'dod na// dza ti dag dang na le sham// sug smel dbyi mong dkar/ po rnams/ zhib btags thun gcig chu la gdab// dus su ldog na grang ba yin// mi ldog par ni gab par 'dod// chu mdog dmar po dag la ni// ga bur tsandan dkar po dang*// na sha ka dang tikta gnyis// legs par zhib btags chu la gda'// dus su ldog na gnyan tshad yin// mi ldog pa ni gnyan rlung yin// de yi bye brag shes par bya// spyir ni chu mdog dmar po la// tshad pa yin pa'i nges pa med// grang rlung mkha' rtsa grol ba la// chu mdog dmar po 'byung ba yod// chu mdog dkar ram sngo ba la// rlung dang grang ba'i nges pa med// gnyan tshad gting du gab pa la// chu mdog rlung dang 'dra ba 'byung*// des na gcig tu nges pa med// de phyir gsang ba'i brtags pa gces// yang nag sang ba'i brtags pa la// phyi yul grang ba lta bu la/ khong du 'u su dwa li btang*// bag tsam bde na rlung du 'dod// bag tsam na na gab tshad yin// phyi yul tshad pa lta bu la// tig ta bang dang dkar po dang*// spangs rtsi do be'i bsdus thang btang*// bde na tshad pa yin par 'dod// bag tsam thu na grang bar bcos// rtag tu log tu ma 'dod na// dug gam gcong nad yin par 'dod// gzhi ni gcung nad yod pa la// rim gsar phog na nyen che bas// gnyen po'i sman rnams ltags sprod btang*// zhes gsungs pa bzhin rtsa chu gnyis dang*/

gnyan bcos las/ rtsa ni phra grim mgyogs par spun/ kha na rgyug na gting na stong*// rlung rtsa tshad pa rgyas 'dra 'byung*// sna tshogs 'gyur ldog can du 'ong*// zhes dang*/ mthong yul la brtag pa ni/ mig ser po la dregs pa chags// mig ris gong tshor 'gro ba yin// mdog nag lce ni dmar la snyam// bad lce dbus su dregs pa chags// gtam la dris te brtags pa ni// tshigs bzhi na zhing khrum gzer khyor// pho ba na zhing 'khru ba dang*/ sogs go sla'o// gnyis pa nad ngos zin nas bcos pa la/ rtsa ba las/ nad de dang po thang gi bcos te/ par pa par pa ta me tog rgyas pa/ zho chen bkra bzang gi thang btang*/ rlung shas che na chang la gdus te btang*// rlung shas che na chang la gdus te btang*// tshad pa dang mkhris pa shas che ba la ka ra gdus te btang*/ ngad yal ba'i dus su btags/ sman rta yang thang gi khu bas bya/ nad babs chung ba la thang rkyang gis chog gsum pa sman gyis bsad pa la/ gnyan bcos las/ gnyan nad bsad pa dang*/ rlung nad gso ba dang*/ tshad nad spur ba dang*/ nad kyi gzhi dang sbyar la skyob kyi sman sbyar ba'i thabs dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sman sbyar ba ni/ gnyan bcos dang shog dril sngon po gnyis mthun par 'byung bas/ a ru ra gser mdog gcig gla ba dri phyin tsam 1 gur gum/ sug smel/ li shi/ ghi waṃ bzhi po thun re re/ cu gang thun phyed/ tsandan dkar po dri che tsam/ shu dag sran ma tsam/ 1 ru rta mang sran ma tsam/ 1 gu gul nag po thun/ 1 spos dkar thun phyed/ 2 sha thun/ 1 sbal sha thun phyed/ lcang mo'i sha thun/ 1 mi yi nya sha ma rul ba thun phyed/ se ba'i me tog thun/ 1 re ljags dkar po'i rtsa ba thun phyed/ par pa ta thun/ 1 spyang ki'i brub thun/ 1 de rnams ka ra dang thang khu'i rta byas te btang*/ khrag rdol ba'i rigs la ru rta cher btags/ bad kan tsha ba rnams la cong zhi bzang po/ rlung shas che ba la sha chen bag tsam cher btang*/ tshad pa che ba la skyong ba'i bar shun kha thur gang sbyar/

mkhris pa la se ba'i me tog dang gser ma'i dug mo nyung sdebs/ srin dang grang ba yod pa la se 'bru dang*/ 'u su thun re gong gi sman dang sdebs de sbyar/ tshad nad bab che ba la thun kyang che bar btang*/ nad bab chung ba dang je drag tu song ba la thun kyang chung bar btang*/ rgas pa rlung shas che ba rnams la chang la sbyar/ gzhon pa dang tshad pa che ba rnams la chu la sbyar nas btang*/ gnyan shas che ba dang mkhris shas che ba la thang gi khu bas btang ngo*// de dag gis gnyan nad gsod pa dang*/ rlung nad gso ba dang*/ tshad nad spur ba rnams dkyus gcig la kha tshar gyis sdebs bsgyur ba'i sgo nas bstan te/ bzhi pa nad kyi gzhi la sbyar nas skyob kyi sman ni/ shog dril ser po las/ tshad pa mgo la bab pa la/ par pa ta se ba'i me tog dang*// skyer ba'i bar shun dag dang ni// 'brug rus rnying pa'i thang yang btang*// tig ta a ru bong nga dkar// hong len gser gyi phud bu rnams// zhib btags ka ra nyid dang sbyar// spyi yi sman dang ltag pa sprad// de yi nges par sel bar byed// gre bar gags pa byung ba la// a ru ra dang rgya tsha dang*// mtshur dang utpal sngon po la// shu dag srun kha khyung sder dang*// tsandan dkar dmar a ka ru// bse ru dkar po kha sha'i rwa// ba le ka dang ba sha ka /brag zhun gu gul tig ta rnams// spyi yi sman dang ltag pa sprad// pho bar bab pa'i tshad pa la// par pa ta dang dom mkhris dang*/ pri yang ku dang skyer bar shun// bong dkar gyi lce gser me tog /zhib btags gong dang ltag pa sprad// yan lag nya rnams 'gyur zhing na// de la ru rtas sku mnye bshad// sha rnams dag dang sbal ba'i sha / sgog skya bsregs pa'i thal ba la// gu gul gla rtsi shing kun dang*// dza ti 'u su sug smel rnams// zhib btags gsar 'jam dag dang sbyar// spyi yi sman dang ltag pa sprad// skrang 'bur dag tu na ba la// spyi yi sman dang seb bong nga dang*// sdom ro skam po bsnan la btang*// des ni nges par sel bar byed// sman rnams mi tshugs snyugs pa na// se lo ljags pa'i thang yang btang*// des ni nges par sel bar byed// 'khru ba mi chod shor ba la// 'u su dan trig mon cha ra// smag dang cong zhi ka sed dang*// brtsod khrag sha chen dom mkhris rnams// zhib btabs rlung la chang dang sbyar// gnyan tshad gang chu dag la sbyar// spyi yi sman dang ltag pa sprad// de yis nges par sel bar byed// tshad pa rus la gab pa la// spyi zhur 'brug rus gang thig rnams// gong gi spyi sman gsob du btang*// ban kan che ba'i rigs rnams la// so 'bru tso zhi se yab dang*// sug smel da li brag zhun rnams// spyi yi sman gyi gsob tu btags// mkhris pa che ba'i rigs rnams la// gser gyi me tog phud bu dang*// se ba'i me tog tig ta dang*// dug mo nyung dang ba sha ka

/gong gi spyi sman gsob tu btang*// rlung dang grang ba che ba la// sha chen 'u su sgog thal dang*// dza ti shing kun tsi tra ka /zhib btags spyi sman gsob tu btags// des ni nges par sel bar byed// ces so// rtsa ba'i gsum pa byong gi bkru ba ni/ snang gsal sgron ma'i shog dril nas// shun du rtsub pa'i gnyan nad dang*// skran dang ma zhu ba yi nad// 'or dang dmu mchu'i nad dang ni// dregs pa grum bu'i nad rnams dang*// gnyan tshad srog la rgol ba la// ltod kyang snang gsal sgron me bstan// thar nu dur byin khron bu dang*// zab klag can dang dan rog dang*// stag sha dang ni gu gul nag /gla rtsi shrī khand+ra dang*// nyi dga' ba dang rgya tsha ba// 'di la sha chen rtsa sbal dang*// lcam mo rkang lag can gyi sha yin zhes snang*/ sha chen rnam rgyal gnyis kyi sha /bong nga sran ma gsum tsam btags// zhib btags ba chus sbrus byas nas// ril bu sran tshad bdun bdun btab// gnyan tshad pho bar ltung ba dang*// gag pa skrang 'bur kun la phan// sbyang rjes skyo tsha tshos so btang*// klad gnyer drag por gyur pa la// tig ta 'brug rus gser me tog /se ba'i me tog zhib btags te// gong gi sman la kha tshar btang*// gzer thung drag po byung ba la// tsandan dkar dmar ru rta dang*// ba sha ka dang ghi wang dang*// dza ti spos dkar cu gang bsnan// btang bas stod gzer zhi bar byed// rgyu gzer drag por gyur ba la// shug tsher dur ba'i phye ma dang*// par pa ta yi 'bras bu dang*// bar shun skyer ba'i bar shun dang*// a phyag dang ni lug mig dang*// cum rtsa tha skar nyi dga' bsnan// gre ba'i gags par skrang 'bur la// gu gul mi zi nag po dang*/ gla rtsi dang ni rgya tsha dang*// tsi dra ka dang big pan rnams// gong gi sman dang sman sbyar la btang*/ sbyang rjes skyo tsha tshos so btang*// zhes so// lnga pa zas dang spyod lam gyis gso ba ni/

srin dang grang ba yod pa la// skom du chang gsar bag re brten// rlung dang grang shas che ba la// lug sha gsar ba'i tshod ma brten// sman 'jug bsring bas ldog mi 'ong*// spyod lam mngar bag sha rul spangs/ khyad par dkar gyi rigs rnams spangs/ gro yi tshod dang tsha skyur dang*// nyin mo gnyid dang drag shul spang*// rkang ba ring bar mi byed do// zhes rtsa bar gsungs so// gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas padma las 'brel rtsal gyis thugs sgrub gter gzhung las brgyus pa dge legs 'phel/// /
